description: This is a source file for an Android Fragment named HomeFragment which constructs the main home screen of an Android TV app. It includes UI setup for hero banners, navigation bars, continuation watching section, TV channels, focus management, and data loading via ViewModel and repository pattern.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment for the home screen of the Android TV app, managing UI setup, focus navigation, and data presentation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and configures the UI hierarchy, including compose and view-based components.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus and observes ViewModel LiveData.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Re-establishes focus when returning to fragment.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes LiveData from ViewModel to update UI based on data load states.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading state for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message and triggers retry.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the continue watching rail with data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV channels rail with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a Compose-based top navigation bar with focus and navigation handling.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Sets up the hero/banner carousel section.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Configures the Continue Watching section with title and horizontal list.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Configures the TV Channels list section.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focusability for rails based on navigation state.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density pixels to actual pixel units.
